title: ADDEX
tagline: ADDEX is one of Dex built in some evm blockchain. User doesn't have to pay for that, because advertisement merchant pay for the gas.
description:
Gas was paid by advertisement merchant.
User can trade without paying gas-fee.
We are assuming that Stable coin Company will pay for the gas fee, so that user will hold the stable coin.

When user want to swap, or liquidity provide, user will pay for the gas, but with this service, user don't have to pay for that, as advertisement company will pay, instead of the user,
This function is called metatransaction.
how_its_made:
Using metatransaction, user doesn't have to pay.
Dex was built using smart contract.

User send signature, then relayer will verify the signature, and send transaction,
That's why ,This DEX user don't have to pay.

We built this product on Neon EVM & Gnosis chain.
This will help user touch crypto easily.
